title: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Organism Specific Culture Detection
description: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Specific determination: Targeted culture detection — organism specific culture technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Threshold presence of a named organism by organism specific culture (MRSA/VRE/Salmonella screening cultures). Contains 13316-5.
